text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
――Now, for the rest of the time, please 
review the choreography freely on your 
own. One, and, two, and...

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um~ Orfevre-san, how is your dance 
practice coming along...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It is useless to me.
Mmh! I cannot overlook those words, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Disobeying the lecturer?! Pay attention in 
class—that is what maintains order!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: There is no hesitation in my choreography.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, repetitive practice is utterly 
pointless.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmhâ¦â¦ But reviewing is important too, 
sir!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Then feast your eyes upon this.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Witness the King's dance, before which all 
subjects shall bow.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
! Orfe-san's footwork... It's so graceful! 
There's not a single wasted motion, or 
rather...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! It's practically divine... I can't 
take my eyes off it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Peeking into the studio where cheers were 
coming from, I found Orfevre dancing.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What a majestic dance...! Indeed, with 
this, she looks ready to take the stage at 
any moment, yes sir!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Only this is worthy of sustaining me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Consider yourselves honored. ...From this 
moment forth, I appoint you as my backup 
dancers.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh, us!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds far more entertaining. 
...Shall we, Instructor?"

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, hmm... There are some things you 
can only gain through practical lessons, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, anyone who wants to, please 
go dance with Orfevre-san!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That is well. ...A lecture fit for a King 
is only appropriate.
choice_data_list:
Even in class, she does things totally her 
own way...!

I see you're thinking about how to make it 
a meaningful time.

You're thinking about how to make it a 
meaningful time, huh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Of course. To reign above all— that is 
what it means to be a "King."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...! However, I cannot overlook 
disrupting order!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please remember this! If I catch the scent 
of a case, I'll rush to the scene no 
matter where it is!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I have gone out of my way to be here. I 
will not tolerate a boring lecture.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see... That makes total sense, sir! 
Police officers also build their response 
skills through realistic situational 
training, after all!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, you may dance. ...Allow me 
to instruct you in the ways of the stage."
